questions.question: A boat's speed in still water is 9 km/h, while the stream’s speed is 1.5 km/h. A man rows to a location 105 km away and then returns to his starting position. The total time taken by him is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Speed of boat in still water = 9 km/h

Speed of stream = 1.5 km/h

Distance = 105 km

**Concept:**

Time is calculated as distance/speed.

**Calculation: **

Time is taken to go upstream = Distance/Speed upstream

105 km/(9 km/h - 1.5 km/h) = 14 hours

Time is taken to come downstream = Distance/Speed downstream

105 km/(9 km/h + 1.5 km/h) = 10 hours

Total time is 14 + 10 = 24 hours.

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: A sofa-set is offered for sale at three successive discounts of 10%, 5%, and 2%. Find the net selling price of the sofa-set, if its marked price is ₹18,000.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Selling Price can be calculated directly by multiplying the Marked Price with the respective discount multiplying factors.

Net SP = 18000 × 0.90 × 0.95 × 0.98

Net SP = 16200 × 0.95 × 0.98 = 15390 × 0.98 = 15082.20

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15,082.20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31c18bf428cc434e99c9f4533ac0a8b572d94e62ce753025d39b67b93c7fc69b.png] 

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹18,000

Successive Discounts = 10%, 5%, and 2%

**Formula Used:**

Net Selling Price = MP × (1 − D₁/100) × (1 − D₂/100) × (1 − D₃/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Net Selling Price = 18000 × (1 − 10/100) × (1 − 5/100) × (1 − 2/100)

⇒ Net Selling Price = 18000 × (90/100) × (95/100) × (98/100)

⇒ Net Selling Price = 18000 × (9/10) × (19/20) × (49/50)

⇒ Net Selling Price = 18000 × (8379 / 10000)

⇒ Net Selling Price = 1.8 × 8379

⇒ Net Selling Price = 15082.20

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15,082.20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

For two successive discounts of a% and b%, the equivalent single discount is given by (a + b − ab/100)%.

Marked Price vs Selling Price

Marked Price (MP) is the maximum retail price displayed on the product. Selling Price (SP) is the amount at which the item is actually sold. SP = MP − Discount.

Discount Percentage Calculation

Discount is strictly calculated on the Marked Price of an article. Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100.

questions.question: Ratio of Copper and Gold in first and second alloy are 3 ∶ 4 and 2 ∶ 5 respectively. 14 kg of the first alloy is mixed with 21 kg of the second alloy. Find the ratio of Copper and Gold, respectively, in the new mixture.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Weight ratio of Alloy 1 and Alloy 2 = 14 : 21 = 2 : 3.

Sum of internal ratio parts for both alloys is equal (3 + 4 = 7 and 2 + 5 = 7).

Multiply the internal Copper and Gold ratios directly by the weight ratio parts.

Total Copper = (3 × 2) + (2 × 3) = 6 + 6 = 12.

Total Gold = (4 × 2) + (5 × 3) = 8 + 15 = 23.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 : 23.**

questions.question: P can do a piece of work in 200 days. Q and R can do the same work in 100 days. P, Q and R started the work together and they worked together for 40 days and then Q left the work and P and R together finished the remaining work in 40 days. Find the number of days in which Q alone can do the total work.
questions.solution:
**Given Data:**

P can complete the work in = 200 days

Q and R together can complete the work in = 100 days

P, Q, and R work together for = 40 days

P and R finish the remaining work in = 40 days

**Concept:**

This problem is related to work and time. The total work done is the product of the rate of work and the time.

**Calculation:**

Work done by P in 1 day = 1/200

⇒ Work done by Q and R in 1 day = 1/100

⇒ Work done by P, Q, and R in 40 days = 40 × (1/200 + 1/100) = 2/3 of the total work

⇒ Therefore, work done by P and R in 40 days = 1 - 2/3 = 1/3 of the total work

⇒ Work done by P and R in 1 day = (1/3)/40 = 1/120

⇒ So, work done by Q in 1 day = 1/100 - 1/200 = 1/200

⇒ Time taken by Q alone to do the work = 1/(1/200) = 200 days

**Therefore, Q alone can do the total work in 200 days.**

questions.question: Find the greatest possible length which can be used to measure exactly the lengths 8 m 75 cm, 1.75 m and 12 m 20 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Lengths to be measured = 8 m 75 cm, 1.75 m, 12 m 20 cm

**Concept:**

The concept of finding the greatest common divisor (GCD) is used here. The GCD of the given lengths will be the greatest length that can measure all of them exactly.

**Calculation:**

Convert all measurements to the same unit (cm): 875 cm, 175 cm, and 1220 cm.

⇒ Find GCD(875, 175, 1220) = 5 cm.

**Therefore, the greatest possible length which can be used to measure exactly the lengths 8 m 75 cm, 1.75 m and 12 m 20 cm is 5 cm.**

questions.question: The difference between simple and compound interests compounded annually on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 4% per annum is Rs. 80. The sum (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
**Given Data:**

Simple Interest and Compound Interest difference = Rs. 80

Time period = 2 years

Interest rate = 4% per annum

**Concept:**

The difference between compound interest and simple interest for 2 years can be found using the formula: CI - SI = P × (r/100)², where P is the principal amount, r is the rate of

interest, CI is the Compound Interest, and SI is the Simple Interest.

**Calculation:**

Using the formula, P × (r/100)² = CI - SI

⇒ Substitute the given values into the formula, P × (4/100)² = 80

Solving for P,

⇒ P = 80/(4/100)² = Rs. 50000 

**Therefore, the sum is Rs. 50000.**

questions.question: In an election between A and B, B secured 16,200 votes and defeated A by 8% of the total votes. If there are no invalid votes, what is the difference in votes between A and B?
questions.solution:
**Given Data:**

Votes secured by B = 16,200

Percentage of votes by which B defeated A = 8%

**Concept:**

The total number of votes can be calculated considering that B won by 8% of total votes. Then, the votes that A received can be derived, and the difference between votes of A and B can be calculated.

**Calculation:**

Total number of votes be 100%

⇒ Votes secured by A be x%

⇒ Votes secured by B be (x + 8)%

According to question

⇒ Total votes = x + x + 8 = 100

⇒ 2x = 92

⇒ x = 46%

⇒ x + 8 = 54%

Votes secured by B be (x + 8)% = 54% = 16200

⇒ 1 % = 300

⇒ 8% = 2400

⇒ Difference between votes of A and B = Votes secured by B - Votes secured by A = 8% = 2400

**Therefore, the difference in votes between A and B is 2400 votes.**

questions.question: The average of 7 natural numbers is 70. Among them six numbers are 32, 69, 72, 65, 79, 48. What is the seventh number?
questions.solution:
**Given Data:**

Average of seven numbers = 70

Six numbers = 32, 69, 72, 65, 79, 48

**Concept:**

The total of seven numbers can be calculated by multiplying the average with 7. Subtracting the sum of given six numbers from this total gives the seventh number.

**Calculation:**

Total of seven numbers = Average × 7 = 70 × 7 = 490.

⇒ Sum of given six numbers = 32 + 69 + 72 + 65 + 79 + 48 = 365.

⇒ Seventh number = Total - Sum of six numbers = 490 - 365 = 125. 

**Therefore, the seventh number is 125.**

questions.question: The area of a right-angled triangle is 42 cm². If its perpendicular is equal to 10 cm, find the length of its base.
questions.solution:
**Given Data:**

Area of the triangle = 42 cm²

Perpendicular (height) = 10 cm

**Concept:**

The area of a right-angled triangle is 1/2 × base × height. The base of the triangle can be derived by rearranging this formula.

**Calculation:**

Base = 2Area/Height = (2× 42 cm²)/10 cm = 8.4 cm.

**Therefore, the length of its **base** is 8.4 cm.**

questions.question: A solid sphere is cut into two equal halves. What is the ratio of the total surface area of each hemisphere to that of the solid sphere?
questions.solution:
**Given Data:**

A solid sphere is cut into two equal halves.

**Concept:**

The total surface area of a sphere is 4πr², and

The total surface area of a hemisphere is 3πr².

**Calculation:**

The ratio of the total surface area of each hemisphere to that of the solid sphere = Surface area of hemisphere/Surface area of sphere = 3πr²/4πr² = 3/4.

**Therefore, the ratio of the total surface area of each hemisphere to that of the solid sphere is 3 ∶ 4.**

questions.question: A car driver is driving car at a speed of 70 km/h and a bus is moving 35 metres ahead of him. After 15 seconds, the bus is 40 metres behind of him. Find the speed of the bus.
questions.solution:
**Given Data:**

Speed of car = 70 km/h

Distance ahead initially = 35 m

Distance behind after 15 seconds = 40 m

**Concept:**

Relative speed and basic physics (Speed = Distance/Time)

**Calculation:**

Speed of car in m/s = 70 × 1000/3600 = 19.44 m/s

In 15 seconds, distance covered by car = 19.44 × 15 = 291.6 m

Distance covered by bus in 15 seconds = 291.6 - 35 (initial lead) - 40 (final lag) = 216.6 m

Speed of bus = Distance/Time = 216.6/15 = 14.44 m/s

Speed of bus in km/h = 14.44 × 3600/1000 = 51.984 km/h ≈ 52 km/h

**Therefore, the speed of the bus is approximately 52 km/h.**

questions.question: In an election contested by two parties, party A secured 16 percent of the total votes more than party B. If party B got 25200 votes and there are no invalid votes, by how many votes did party B lose the election?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the total number of votes be 100%.

The margin of loss is given as 16%, so Party B's vote share = (100% − 16%) ÷ 2 = 42%.

We are given that 42% of total votes = 25200.

Party B lost by the difference of 16%.

Margin of loss = (25200 ÷ 42) × 16 = 600 × 16 = 9600 votes.

**∴ The correct answer is 9600 votes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference in vote percentage between Party A and Party B = 16% of total votes

Votes secured by Party B = 25200

There are no invalid votes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3276f37536c2a7ec8ba9869f5baec29677757c79efa718fd58d5dc409f6db115.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total number of votes be 100%.

⇒ Votes of Party A − Votes of Party B = 16%

⇒ Votes of Party A + Votes of Party B = 100%

⇒ Substitute Party A's share: (Votes of Party B + 16%) + Votes of Party B = 100%

⇒ 2 × Votes of Party B = 100% − 16% = 84%

⇒ Votes of Party B = 42%

⇒ According to the question, 42% of Total Votes = 25200

⇒ 1% of Total Votes = 25200 ÷ 42 = 600

⇒ Party B lost by the difference in votes, which is exactly 16% of total votes.

⇒ Margin of loss = 16 × 600 = 9600 votes.

**∴ The correct answer is 9600 votes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Election Base Concept

In election problems, the total valid votes are always considered as 100%. If there are only two candidates and no invalid votes, the winner's percentage and loser's percentage will always sum up to exactly 100%.

Winning Margin

The margin by which a candidate wins or loses the election is given by the direct difference between their respective vote percentages. Winning Margin = Winner% − Loser%.

Invalid Votes Rule

When invalid votes are present, Total Cast Votes = Valid Votes + Invalid Votes. Candidates' shares are usually calculated as a percentage of valid votes, unless the question explicitly specifies it as a percentage of total registered voters.
